claims.claim: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million orbital compute modules forming the Starmind constellation with at least one station required by 2033 and full deployment by 2040.
claims.episode_span: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million orbital compute modules forming the Starmind constellation. The order requires at least one authorized space station by 2033 and full deployment by 2040.
claims.source_title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
claims.supporting_quote: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission lauded its authorization as a historic first amid the artificial intelligence race. It said that SpaceX's 1 million "orbital compute modules" (forming a data center constellation called "Starmind") would process massive amounts of data that would be used back on Earth—and bring humans closer to harnessing "the full power of the sun."

claims.claim: Europa Clipper will fly within 1,950 to 2,133 miles of Earth on December 3 to gain a gravity-assist boost toward Jupiter.
claims.episode_span: NASA’s Europa Clipper will fly within 1,950 to 2,133 miles of Earth on December 3 to gain a gravity-assist boost toward Jupiter.
claims.source_title: NASA's Europa Clipper zooming by Earth on way to Jupiter's icy moon
claims.supporting_quote: NASA’s Europa Clipper will soon swing past Earth before making a yearslong beeline for Jupiter, where the orbiter will probe whether the ocean beneath its moon Europa's icy shell has the ingredients for life.

claims.claim: Hubble observed the Milky Way’s galactic bulge in red and near-infrared wavelengths that overlap with the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
claims.episode_span: Hubble observed the Milky Way’s galactic bulge in red and near-infrared wavelengths that overlap with the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
claims.source_title: NASA's Hubble views ocean of stars in groundwork for Roman
claims.supporting_quote: Hubble views the universe primarily in ultraviolet, visible and near-infrared light, while Roman collects data in near-infrared light and some visible light. Because researchers wish to compare Hubble's observations to future Roman observations, Hubble looked at the region in wavelengths that overlap with Roman's areas of sensitivity, the red end of the visible spectrum and near-infrared wavelengths.

claims.claim: The Delizz strawberry variety outperformed a wild type that produced too many runners in flight-like growth chambers.
claims.episode_span: Researchers grew strawberries in flight-like chambers and found the Delizz variety outperformed a wild type that produced too many runners.
claims.source_title: NASA Eyes Crop Candidates for Future Menus
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida are growing strawberries in flight-like growth chambers to evaluate the potential space crop, and NASA partners at The Australian Research Council Centre for Excellence in Plants for Space also are helping expand knowledge of space strawberries.

claims.claim: The 550-brick New Glenn LEGO set stands 10.5 inches tall and is sold for $294.95 through the Blue Origin website.
claims.episode_span: The 550-brick set depicts the New Glenn rocket and Jacklyn landing barge and stands 10.5 inches tall when complete. It is sold exclusively through the Blue Origin website for $294.95 with deliveries expected the week of November 30.
claims.source_title: Official LEGO New Glenn Rocket and Jacklyn Landing Barge Set Is Not Sold by LEGO
claims.supporting_quote: The toy is rather small, as it only needs 550 bricks to come together and form something that looks like the company's star rocket and the barge that was built as a sort of offshore landing pad. When completed, the set stands 10.5 inches (27 cm) tall.

claims.claim: A Landsat 9 Operational Land Imager image acquired December 12, 2025 shows Resolution Island rising to Mount Clerke at 1,069 meters.
claims.episode_span: An Operational Land Imager image from Landsat 9 on December 12, 2025 shows Resolution Island rising to Mount Clerke at 1,069 meters amid Fiordland’s glacier-carved valleys.
claims.supporting_quote: This image, acquired with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 on December 12, 2025, shows the island’s setting amid a landscape of steep-sided valleys carved by glaciers and now inundated by the ocean. The uninhabited island rises from sea level to the summit of Mount Clerke at 1,069 meters (3,507 feet).

claims.claim: NASA signed a nearly $500,000 Mentor-Protégé Agreement between Boeing and GRACE Aerospace on October 29, 2026 at the U.S. Space and Rocket Center.
claims.episode_span: The agreement signed October 29, 2026 at the U.S. Space and Rocket Center in Huntsville values nearly $500,000 and pairs Boeing with GRACE Aerospace.
claims.source_title: NASA Enhances Supplier Program, Announces Mentor-Protégé Agreement
claims.supporting_quote: NASA’s Office of Small Business Programs (OSBP) hosted a ceremonial Mentor-Protégé Agreement signing between The Boeing Company and GRACE Aerospace on Oct. 29, 2026, at the U.S. Space and Rocket Center in Huntsville, Alabama.
